Full-table mode

iPhone Safari reserves its browser chrome for normal tabs. Interactive HTML gets the browserless canvas when Klondike is launched as a Home Screen web app.

  1. Tap Safari’s Share button.
  2. Choose Add to Home Screen.
  3. Keep Open as Web App enabled.
  4. Launch Klondike from its Home Screen icon, then rotate to landscape.
